articles.title: Grupo Marbor consolida empreendimentos como referências em Mogi das Cruzes | G1
articles.standfirst: Vila Helio supera 90% de ocupação comercial, enquanto hotelaria e eventos ampliam a movimentação de visitantes e negócios na cidade
articles.summary: Vila Helio supera 90% de ocupação comercial, enquanto hotelaria e eventos ampliam a movimentação de visitantes e negócios na cidade
articles.body:
A elevada ocupação dos espaços comerciais, a procura por hospedagem e a movimentação de visitantes refletem a presença dos empreendimentos do Grupo Marbor na dinâmica econômica de Mogi das Cruzes. Com atuação nos setores imobiliário e de hotelaria, a empresa mogiana reúne negócios que atendem diferentes perfis de público e mantém investimentos voltados à qualificação de suas estruturas e à ampliação do portfólio.

Na Vila Helio, cerca de 80 empreendimentos de diferentes segmentos compartilham um espaço que concentra comércio, serviços e gastronomia. No Hotel Marbor, a procura por hospedagem e a recorrência de clientes também demonstram a atratividade da operação. A programação cultural e de lazer complementa essa movimentação, atraindo visitantes e ampliando as oportunidades para os estabelecimentos instalados no complexo.

Para o Grupo Marbor, que completou 38 anos em 2026, esses resultados fazem parte de uma gestão que acompanha o desempenho dos negócios e as necessidades de empresas, consumidores e hóspedes. Os indicadores de ocupação, circulação de público e desempenho das operações orientam decisões e ajudam a identificar oportunidades de investimento e crescimento.

A ocupação como indicador de preferência

Com cerca de 80 empreendimentos instalados e mais de 90% de ocupação, a Vila Helio reúne empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos em um espaço que combina infraestrutura comercial, serviços e circulação de público.

A diversidade de operações contribui para manter o complexo ativo e ampliar as possibilidades de consumo e relacionamento com os visitantes. A gestão privada do complexo contempla manutenção, conservação das áreas comuns e serviços de apoio, condições que contribuem para a atratividade dos imóveis e a permanência das empresas.

“Uma ocupação elevada é um indicador importante de atratividade, mas a consistência do negócio está na capacidade de manter essa demanda ao longo do tempo. Isso exige uma gestão próxima das operações, investimentos permanentes na infraestrutura e atenção à qualidade dos espaços. É assim que preservamos o valor dos nossos ativos e construímos relações duradouras com as empresas instaladas”, avalia Tatiana Borenstein, diretora do Grupo Marbor.

Hotel Marbor mantém procura e investe na modernização

O Hotel Marbor mantém uma demanda expressiva por hospedagem, com períodos de alta ocupação e clientes que retornam regularmente a Mogi das Cruzes. O empreendimento recebe profissionais, famílias, artistas, atletas e grupos que chegam à região para compromissos, eventos e lazer.

Com 107 apartamentos distribuídos em sete categorias, o hotel atende diferentes necessidades de hospedagem. A recorrência dos clientes e as avaliações nas plataformas especializadas estão entre os indicadores acompanhados pela administração para avaliar a qualidade dos serviços e a experiência dos hóspedes.

Além da hospedagem, o Hotel Marbor também vem ampliando sua relação com o público local por meio do café da manhã, disponível inclusive para quem não está hospedado. O serviço também ganha edições temáticas em datas como Dia das Mães, Dia dos Pais e Halloween, atraindo moradores de Mogi das Cruzes para experiências gastronômicas em diferentes ocasiões.

A operação também passa por uma nova etapa de investimentos. O projeto de retrofit do Hotel Marbor, iniciado no último trimestre de 2026, contempla a modernização de áreas comuns, com melhorias voltadas ao conforto dos hóspedes e à atualização da estrutura do empreendimento.

Ao longo do ano, a Vila Helio mantém uma programação cultural mensal diversificada, com eventos organizados pelo Grupo Marbor, administrador do espaço, e também realizados por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura (LIC) de Mogi das Cruzes.) — Foto: Divulgação/Grupo Marbor

A programação cultural e de lazer também contribui para a circulação de visitantes na Vila Helio. Entre as atrações realizadas em 2026 estão o Sambadou na Vila, o Mogi Jazz & Blues Fest e o Dia de Brincar, iniciativas que reuniram diferentes públicos no Centro de Mogi das Cruzes.

Ao todo, os eventos realizados no complexo receberam mais de 10 mil pessoas. Além de ampliar as opções de lazer na cidade, essas atividades favorecem o contato do público com os estabelecimentos instalados na Vila Helio, especialmente os de gastronomia.

A programação de fim de ano dá continuidade a essa agenda, com apresentações de corais natalinos, presença do Papai Noel e bazar. As atrações já integram o calendário de atividades procuradas pelas famílias mogianas. Para este ano, a expectativa é receber entre 8 mil e 10 mil visitantes durante os dias de eventos.

Parte das iniciativas culturais conta com patrocínio por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura (LIC) da Prefeitura de Mogi das Cruzes, enquanto outras são realizadas por organização privada.

O galpão localizado na Avenida Fernando Costa, em Mogi das Cruzes, tem 572,70 m² de área construída e integra o portfólio imobiliário do Grupo Marbor.) — Foto: Divulgação/Grupo Marbor

Crescimento acompanhado por investimentos

A expansão do portfólio imobiliário integra a estratégia de crescimento do Grupo Marbor, que administra mais de 20 mil m² de Área Bruta Locável (ABL) em imóveis comerciais. Entre os movimentos recentes estão a aquisição de duas propriedades ocupadas por agências do Banco do Brasil e do Itaú, na região central de Mogi das Cruzes, e a incorporação de um imóvel com 572,70 m² de área construída na Avenida Fernando Costa.

A ampliação do patrimônio ocorre em paralelo aos investimentos nos empreendimentos já administrados, como a modernização do Hotel Marbor e a conservação permanente da Vila Helio. A estratégia combina a qualificação dos ativos existentes com a identificação de novas oportunidades no mercado imobiliário.

“Nosso crescimento é resultado de decisões fundamentadas no desempenho dos negócios e na identificação de oportunidades. Acompanhamos indicadores, avaliamos a capacidade de cada empreendimento de gerar valor e direcionamos os investimentos para preservar a competitividade do portfólio. Temos uma visão de longo prazo, que combina a qualificação dos ativos existentes com a expansão para novos mercados”, afirma Tatiana.

Com negócios consolidados em Mogi das Cruzes e expansão de atuação, o Grupo Marbor mantém uma estratégia de crescimento baseada na gestão de seus empreendimentos, na valorização dos ativos e na identificação de oportunidades em diferentes mercados.

Para acompanhar os empreendimentos e a agenda de eventos do Grupo Marbor, acesse ou acompanhe @grupo_marbor nas redes sociais.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss reunite at Chiefs game, a decade after their rumored rift
articles.summary: The onetime BFFs have not been photographed together since 2018.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss reunited at the Kansas City Chiefs game on Sunday, a decade after their rumored rift.

The two cheered on Swift's husband, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce.

Kloss shocked Swifties in July when she attended the singer's wedding at Madison Square Garden.

It's a friendship story, baby — Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss were spotted together for the first time in nearly a decade on Sunday.

The "Patient Zero" singer invited Kloss to join her inside her private suite at Arrowhead Stadium to cheer on husband Travis Kelce and the Kansas City Chiefs as they defeated the New York Jets. The two sat side by side, smiling and laughing the entire game, surrounded by Swift's mother Andrea Swift and mother-in-law Donna Kelce.

Swift and Kloss were last photographed together in August 2018, when the supermodel went backstage at the Reputation Stadium Tour's stop in Nashville. However, the friendly selfie did little to quiet speculation about a rift between the BFFs, after Kloss remained close to Kim Kardashian amid her and Kanye West's public feud with Swift.

Two months later, when she married Josh Kushner, her close friend of five years wasn't in attendance. The singer also didn't make an appearance at the couple's second ceremony in June 2019. Curiously, two of her rivals were on the guest list: Katy Perry, the reported inspiration for Swift's "Bad Blood," and Scooter Braun, whom she had accused of "manipulative bullying" after he purchased the masters of her first six albums that month.

But over the years since, the frost between Swift and Kloss has slowly thawed.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

In 2023, the model was spotted singing and dancing at a Los Angeles concert on Swift's Eras Tour. Out of the public eye, the two seemingly mended the rift. This past July, Swifties were shocked to see Kloss and her husband arriving at Madison Square Garden for the singer's wedding to Kelce.

Kloss remained mum about the invite when asked weeks later on the Today show. However, she couldn't help but gush about her friend's real-life love story: "What I will say is that they're an amazing couple and I'm so happy for them."

Read the original article on Entertainment Weekly

articles.title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' box office collection day 5: Ranbir Kapoor's film rakes MASSIVE Rs 107 crore in a single day; crosses Rs 346 crore net in India
articles.summary: Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana: Part 1' has turned Diwali into a celebration for the film industry.
articles.body: Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana: Part 1' has turned Diwali into a celebration for the film industry. The Ranbir Kapoor starrer has reportedly entered the Rs 500 crore club worldwide in just four days, driven by glowing reviews and the festive holiday rush. The epic has also put to rest the long-standing belief that big films falter in the run-up to the festival.Ramayana Movie Review‘Ramayana: Part 1’ box office collection day 5 According to industry tracker Sacnilk, 'Ramayana' is running in 23,862 shows on Day 5 and has netted Rs 107.50 Cr so far today. Hindi contributed the bulk at Rs 87.32 Cr from 19,743 shows, while Kannada added Rs 7.50 Cr from 908 shows, Telugu Rs 6 Cr from 1606 shows and Tamil Rs 4 Cr from 823 shows. The film’s India gross collection has reached Rs 413.90 Cr, while the India net collection is now Rs 346.35 Cr, and the final India numbers are still awaited.Day wise collection of 'Ramayana: Part 1'Day 1 (Thursday) - Rs 64.85 croreDay 2 (Friday) - Rs 48.05 croreDay 3 (Saturday) - Rs 69.80 croreDay 4 (Sunday) - Rs 56.15 croreDay 5 (Monday) - Rs 107.50 crore (LIVE)Total - Rs 346.35 crore‘Ramayana: Part 1’ becomes fifth highest grossing film of 2026Made on a reported budget of Rs 4000 crore, 'Ramayana' has already become the fifth highest grossing film of 2026. It still has to surpass 'Border 2', 'Drishyam 3', 'Jailer 2' and 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge'.‘Ramayana: Part 1’ cast and crewAfter a strong response over the Diwali weekend, 'Ramayana: Part 1' is expected to keep up its box office momentum. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravie Dubey as Laxman, Arun Govil as King Dashrath, Indira Krishnan as Kaushalya, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, Sheeba Chaddha as Manthara, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha and Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari.The first part hit theatres on November 5, while the second part, earlier planned for a release around Diwali next year, has reportedly been pushed to 2028.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Naruto live-action movie reveals a major clue about its storyline as a dangerous first mission takes centre stage
articles.summary: The upcoming Naruto live-action movie may be taking fans back to the moment that truly tested Naruto Uzumaki as a young ninja.
articles.body: The upcoming Naruto live-action movie may be taking fans back to the moment that truly tested Naruto Uzumaki as a young ninja. New details about the film’s reported storyline suggest that its first major adventure will draw from the early days of the beloved manga and anime. The project has already sparked debate over its casting choices and the ages of its central characters. Now, its reported plot offers a stronger clue about which part of Naruto’s journey could reach the big screen.Naruto live-action movie plot points to the first ninja missionAccording to a report from Knight Edge Media, the film will follow Naruto as he takes on his first mission with Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno. The reported synopsis describes a routine assignment that quickly turns into a dangerous encounter, forcing the young ninja to face a power he does not fully understand.The synopsis reads:"The Naruto story unfolds in a breathtaking alternate universe, where every child dreams of becoming a ninja. We follow Naruto Uzumaki, an exceptionally gifted but challenging new recruit, as he’s assigned to his first mission alongside reluctant teammates Sasuke and Sakura. The mission turns into something far more dangerous and sinister than anticipated, and Naruto is forced to confront his inner demons – including the literal demon that’s revealed to be the root of his own power."The description does not name the enemy or explain where the mission takes place. Still, it brings one of the franchise’s most memorable early storylines into focus.In the original manga and anime, Naruto’s first major assignment outside the village leads into the Land of Waves arc. The story introduces the dangerous rogue ninja Zabuza Momochi and his young companion, Haku. It also gives Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura their first serious test as a team.That storyline could offer the filmmakers a natural starting point. It has emotional stakes, intense fights and room to establish the bonds between the three young ninjas. However, the studio has not confirmed that Zabuza and Haku will appear in the movie.Naruto casting raises questions about character agesThe film’s casting process has also left fans guessing about the adaptation’s timeline. In July, Lionsgate reportedly sought Asian actors aged 18 and older to portray Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura as 16-year-old characters.That initially suggested the movie might move the characters forward from their original ages of around 12. But a second casting call, reportedly issued two weeks ago, sought actors aged 13 to 15 for Naruto and Sakura.The change has created uncertainty about how old the characters will be in the finished film. No official explanation has clarified the different age requirements.Production is expected to begin in the United Kingdom early next year. Until Lionsgate shares more details, the first-mission storyline remains the clearest indication of the direction the live-action Naruto movie could take.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Hilary Duff says child stardom left ‘scars from the past’: ‘People don’t survive that’
articles.summary: Hilary Duff opened up about how she had to confront "scars from the past" after returning to the stage for her "Lucky Me Tour" following 20 years away.
articles.body: Hilary Duff is opening up about the "scars from the past" she had to confront as a former child star. In a recent interview with Billboard, the 39-year-old actress and singer, who rose to fame at 14 when she starred in the hit Disney Channel series "Lizzie McGuire," reflected on the lasting effects of childhood stardom as she discussed her return to music after more than a decade. In February, Duff released "Luck … Or Something," her first studio album since 2015's "Breathe In. Breathe Out." The album debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 chart. In June, Duff launched the "Lucky Me Tour," her first major tour in nearly two decades. BELLA THORNE SAYS HOLLYWOOD TREATED HER LIKE A KID ON SCREEN AND AN ADULT OFF CAMERA Before launching her tour, Duff gave an intimate performance for friends and family in Los Angeles in January. She told Billboard that she was so nervous during the show that her hand shook as she held the microphone. The "Younger" star recalled that after the performance, her son, Luca, told her he was proud of her for returning to the stage despite her fears. "That stuck with me, because it is scary, and I'm used to being so tough and strong," she said. "This industry really makes you very rough around the edges, where you're like, 'I've got to handle this, so I just will.'" "But it was scary to step onstage after 20 years and figure out my identity, and how I move my body and what I'm taking from my old persona and adding to who I am now," Duff continued. "It was a complicated thing to do, and I had to get over quite a few scars from the past." FORMER DISNEY STAR DYLAN SPROUSE SAYS ACTING AS A KID WAS ‘CHILD LABOR’ Although she stepped away from music for more than a decade, Duff said some of the habits she developed during her years as a child star have been difficult to shake. According to Billboard, Duff repeatedly referred to herself as a "Disney dog" during the interview, describing an ingrained impulse to "say yes and to go, go, go." DOLLY PARTON DEFIED COUNTRY MUSIC'S EXPECTATIONS FOR WOMEN AND BUILT A CAREER ON HER OWN TERMS: EXPERTS Duff also said returning to music as an adult has allowed her to take greater control of her career than she had as a child star. "It was wonderful building this on my terms," she said. "I don't mean that negatively in regard to how anything was handled in the past, because I was a child in the past. I wasn't muted, and I got to make decisions, but people made a lot of decisions for me because I didn't care or know enough to be like, 'Here's how I want this.'" DISNEY ALUM CHRISTY CARLSON ROMANO RIPS HOLLYWOOD FOR FAILING CHILD STARS AFTER HAYDEN PANETTIERE’S DEATH Duff also acknowledged that she continues to grapple with the experience of becoming famous at a young age. "I also am a child star, and that's a really hard thing to wrestle with as an adult. People don't survive that." 'AMERICAN IDOL' STAR JUSTIN GUARINI ENDURED DARK SPIRAL AFTER HOLLYWOOD DREAM COLLAPSED "The fact that I've been able to survive and that I get to have this moment … I get to send love to grown-up Hilary and be like, 'You did it!' and also send love to little Hilary and be like, 'Hey, we're still here. Look at what we did.'" The "Lucky Me Tour" kicked off on June 21 in West Palm Beach, Florida, and included stops at Madison Square Garden in New York City and the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California, before heading to Europe, Australia and New Zealand. articles.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight dominates Crunchyroll rankings, but its latest episode faces an unexpected ratings disaster
articles.summary: A strong streaming performance usually signals that an anime has found its audience.
articles.body: A strong streaming performance usually signals that an anime has found its audience. But even a popular series can stumble when an episode fails to deliver what viewers expect. The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System is facing that contrast after its latest instalment received a disappointing IMDb score. The setback comes at an interesting time, as the fantasy series recently climbed to the top of Crunchyroll's worldwide rankings, leaving its growing success and mixed episode reception at odds.The Exiled Heavy Knight episode 19 takes a hit on IMDbEpisode 19 has received a rating of 6.8/10 on IMDb, making it the second-lowest-rated episode of the series as of November 9, 2026. The score marks a noticeable drop from Episode 18, which earned 7.8/10.The change in pace may explain some of the difference. After several episodes focused on dangerous opponents, battles and Elymas Edvaughn's unusual approach to combat, the story takes a quieter route.Elymas and Ruche head to an underground lake after placing an order for new equipment with the blacksmith Veruga. Their break soon turns into a fishing contest when Mary, the leader of the Sea Dragon's Fang angler clan, challenges Elymas.The idea offers a chance to see a different side of the characters. Yet, viewers who had been following the anime for its action and clever use of game mechanics may not have welcomed the slower storyline with the same enthusiasm.A fishing competition is not necessarily a problem for a fantasy adventure. Such episodes can build relationships and give the main characters room to breathe. However, timing matters. After a run of intense encounters, the shift may have felt abrupt to some viewers.The 6.8 rating reflects the episode's reception on IMDb, although it does not establish why individual viewers rated it lower.The Exiled Heavy Knight continues to dominate Crunchyroll rankingsDespite the criticism surrounding Episode 19, the anime has maintained impressive momentum on streaming platforms. FlixPatrol's worldwide Crunchyroll TV show rankings placed The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System at No. 1 on November 7, 2026, with 78 points.It ranked ahead of established titles such as The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover and Solo Leveling. That achievement suggests the series continues to attract a substantial audience, even as one episode struggles to match the reception of earlier instalments.Much of the appeal comes from Elymas himself. Rather than relying only on overwhelming strength, he uses his understanding of the game's mechanics to make an overlooked Heavy Knight class surprisingly formidable. That approach gives the series a distinct hook in a crowded fantasy anime landscape.With 26 episodes planned, the show still has room to regain momentum. A return to high-stakes battles, smart strategies and meaningful character development could help restore the excitement that drew viewers in. For now, its streaming success remains strong, even as Episode 19 stands out as a rare stumble.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Russell Brand sentenced after rape, sexual assault convictions in UK
articles.summary: Russell Brand was sentenced Monday after being found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in the U.K.
articles.body: Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault. During sentencing on Monday, Judge Mr. Justice Joel Bennathan said Brand had demonstrated a "casual and arrogant disregard" for women’s right to refuse his sexual advances. "About 20 years ago, Russell Brand, you were becoming famous," Bennathan said. "You were clever — and in many people’s eyes, funny and charismatic. You had also become a sexual predator." The judge described one of Brand’s sexual assaults as "outrageous and possibly laddish, but also a criminal offense," adding that Brand’s behavior reflected his belief that "fame meant you could act how you liked, when you liked, unhindered by the rules by which decent people live." RUSSELL BRAND FOUND GUILTY OF ONE COUNT OF RAPE AND THREE COUNTS OF SEXUAL ASSAULT Bennathan also said Brand’s conduct showed a "casual arrogant disregard of anyone’s right to say no," and emphasized that women retain the right to refuse sexual contact "wherever they go, indeed whatever they drink." The judge said the victims suffered "profound and lasting" consequences, including trauma, humiliation, addiction and difficulty trusting others. He also praised the women for their "determination and bravery" after they endured Brand's assertions that they had lied about the encounters or consented to them. Bennathan said he considered Brand’s lack of significant prior convictions, the 17 years that had passed since the offenses and his work helping people struggling with addiction. However, he said good character and exemplary conduct should not normally be given significant weight in cases involving serious sexual offenses. According to Sky News, as Brand was taken from the dock by three guards, he turned to his wife and nodded, saying, "We'll be OK." Laura reportedly mouthed back: "I love you, I'll be OK." WATCH: RUSSELL BRAND SENTENCED TO MORE THAN 10 YEARS IN PRISON Last week, Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in the U.K. He denied the charges and was acquitted of two additional rape charges and one count of attempted indecent assault. He was immediately taken into custody following the verdict, according to the BBC. Brand, 51, was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault involving six women between 1999 and 2009. One woman he was convicted of sexually assaulting gave an impact statement during Monday's proceedings, while three others submitted written statements to the prosecutor. "For many years as his star was rising it was impossible to escape seeing him all over the media, being celebrated for his disgusting behavior against women like it was all a joke," she said. "There were many times I felt visibly sick at the sight of him parading around thinking he can get away with anything." The woman spoke out of view of the courtroom to preserve her identity. Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones read statements by the other three women. Brand was convicted of sexually assaulting the first woman at a London radio station in 2005. "Since the sexual assault ... Russell Brand has managed to move on and even forget," she wrote. "Over the years, hearing his voice on television, on social media or seeing his image made me jump." According to Sky News, Brand acknowledged that he had been "reckless" and used his fame to pursue sexual relationships, but insisted that the encounters were consensual. He also told the jury that consent was "fundamental, essential and necessary." Brand has denied forcing any of the women to engage in sexual activity against their will. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Prosecutors alleged that Brand committed the offenses against six women over a 10-year period. The women testified in court about alleged encounters at a hotel, a bar, a radio station, a workplace and Brand’s home. According to a Metropolitan Police press release, detectives began investigating Brand after allegations were made public by U.K. media outlets Channel 4 and The Sunday Times in September 2023. Both contained a number of anonymous complaints, with women accusing Brand of physical and emotional abuse and bullying, as well as some instances of sexual assault. articles.title: Gritos de “presidente, presidente” y banderas de España en el momento de la llegada de Abascal al Teatro Albéniz para su entrevista en ‘La Revuelta’
articles.standfirst: El líder de Vox abrirá la semana en el programa del ente público presentado por David Broncano
articles.summary: El líder de Vox abrirá la semana en el programa del ente público presentado por David Broncano
articles.body: Este lunes, 9 de noviembre, David Broncano arrancará la semana en ‘La Revuelta’ recibiendo a Santiago Abascal, líder de Vox. El televisivo acoge la visita del máximo mandatario de la formación verde tras las de Pedro Sánchez, jefe del Ejecutivo; Gabriel Rufián, portavoz de ERC; e Irene Montero, líder de Podemos, hace unas semanas con motivo de las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre (29N). El Teatro Albéniz de la capital de España se ha vestido de gala para la ocasión para recibir a Santiago Abascal. Eso sí, su visita no ha estado exenta de polémica. El pasado viernes, 6 de noviembre, las personas que iban a acudir a la primera entrega de la semana del espacio del ente público recibieron un e-mail cancelando su visita. El mencionado correo electrónico, enviado por una de las productoras del espacio televisivo, El Terrat, apuntaba que por “circunstancias especiales” se grabará en condiciones distintas de calendario y de público. Esto causó quejas y malestar entre los asistentes, que mostraron su enfado en la red social X. En este contexto, Santiago Abascal acudió al escenario para grabar la entrevista con David Broncano. Cabe recordar que el programa es grabado cada tarde en el plató del Teatro Albéniz de Madrid. Los medios de comunicación esperaban expectantes en la puerta del lugar para captar la llegada del líder de Vox. Abascal llegó acompañado de lo que parece ser su equipo de seguridad, al mismo tiempo que los periodistas se agolpaban sobre él. Además, había una gran cantidad de personas con la bandera de España en los alrededores que le recibieron al grito de “presidente, presidente” y aplausos y silbidos. El propio Santiago Abascal reaccionó con un saludo y un guiño a todos los presentes ante las muestras de cariño recibidas.

articles.title: Chris Rock says he 'was not a great husband' to Malaak Compton-Rock, admits he watched 'a lot of porn'
articles.summary: Chris Rock admitted to cheating and porn addiction during his nearly 20-year marriage to Malaak Compton-Rock, comparing himself to a Marvel character.
articles.body: Chris Rock is going into detail about the end of his marriage, admitting he wasn't the best husband and took accountability for mistakes he made in the relationship. During a recent interview with GQ, the 61-year-old comedian shared that there were many factors that caused the divorce, noting he cheated and was addicted to pornography during his marriage. "I was not a great husband," he admitted. "I watched a lot of porn. I don’t watch porn anymore. I haven’t watched porn in five, six years." He also admitted to cheating on his wife, noting, "It’s not anything I’m proud of, but it’s something I had to go through." CHRIS ROCK SHREDS 'WOKE 1.0' ERA, COMPARES MODERN OUTRAGE TO SALEM WITCH HUNTS The comedian compared himself to a character in a Marvel movie who "has to test his powers" and see how far they can push things before they eventually "crash down." "Every Marvel movie, man or woman, they have to test their powers," he said. "They’re a- -holes. They get these powers and they’re a- -holes, and they’re racing trains and they’re lifting up ocean liners and they try to go to the sun, then they crash down because they realize they’re not God. And then they start helping people." He explained that he "tested my powers" during his marriage by cheating on his wife, noting he "was severely humbled" when he realized he definitely "wasn't God or anywhere near him." Rock was married to Malaak Compton-Rock for nearly 20 years. They tied the knot in 1996, separated in 2014 and finalized their divorce in 2016. They share two children together, daughters, Lola and Zahra. He explained that some of the reason behind that is that he got divorced. "Nobody has a successful divorce, so that takes time," he said. "Then once it’s done, okay, you’re not sitting on the money you had before, so now you got to really make some money. So you go on tour, or two tours. So there was a lot of stand-up. There was a lot of getting my life together. You got a pandemic, you got a bunch of nonsense going on there." "Misty Green" follows an award-winning actress, Misty Green, who is working hard to make a comeback after years of watching her career slowly fade away, with Rock portraying a casting director who once worked with the actress. articles.title: Billboard charts will include YouTube’s streaming data again starting next year.
articles.summary:
YouTube’s data is returning after Billboard changed how it counts ad-supported streams in chart rankings. Starting in January, 1,000 paid streams will be counted the same as 1,500 ad-supported streams, a narrower gap than the previous ratio, which YouTube said ignored “the massive engagement from fans who don’t have a subscription.”
